# Per-document ISO 27001 Annex A validity

An ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A control code cited in a document's ISO-labelled
framework table is a real code in the 2022 Annex A structure. The check validates
four token shapes wherever they appear in a cell governed by an edition-pinned ISO
27001:2022 label: a theme-only reference (a theme letter-number that must be a real
Annex A theme), a single control (theme-and-number, validated against the theme's
control range), a range (validated at both endpoints, rejected if it spans two themes
or is inverted), and a clause reference (validated against the standard's clause
range). Ranges are matched and consumed first so a range endpoint is not re-counted
as a stand-alone code; single codes are then blanked before the theme-only pass so a
code's leading theme is not mistaken for a theme-only token. Both table orientations
are handled: framework-as-column (a table whose header names an ISO column) and
framework-as-row (a row whose first cell names ISO, validating the adjacent code
cell). The label match is edition-pinned to the 2022 edition so a code is validated
against the correct structure. The Annex A reference structure is supplied by the
adopter (the framework catalogue) and is not part of this clause; the central
compliance matrix is validated by a separate check and is excluded here. A document
whose ISO codes are all valid 2022 Annex A references contributes no findings.
